about: Performance budget of the storefront audit (setup/audit/lighthouse.mjs). Each page fails the lighthouse workflow when the median of its runs is worse than its reference value moved by the tolerance of the metric: lower for a score, higher for a time, a shift, a weight or a request count. The reference is a measure of the workflow itself, written here by hand with its date and commit: it is raised when an improvement is acquired, never rewritten from the last run.
